attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Vermont military retirement exemption calculation (2025). AGI-based: Full exemption if AGI ≤ $125k, partial (phase-out) if $125k-$175k, no exemption if AGI > $175k. Source: MOAA State Report Card, Vermont tax law changes effective 2025.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize VT military retirement exemption calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "VT Military Retirement Exemption Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.vt_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.vt_military_retirement_taxable xdef

action_details.action_comment: Apply VT full military retirement exemption (AGI ≤ $125,000)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay /result.vt_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.vt_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"VT military retirement: FULL EXEMPTION (AGI ≤ $125k). Retirement pay: $" result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", AGI: $" strconcat result.agi cvs strconcat ", Exempt: $" strconcat result.vt_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Apply VT partial military retirement exemption (AGI phase-out)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.vt_military_agi_no_exemption_threshold result.agi sub 50000.0 div /vt_exemption_percentage xdef
result.military_retirement_pay vt_exemption_percentage mul /result.vt_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.vt_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.vt_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"VT military retirement: PARTIAL EXEMPTION (AGI $125k-$175k). Retirement pay: $" result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", AGI: $" strconcat result.agi cvs strconcat ", Exempt: $" strconcat result.vt_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (" strconcat vt_exemption_percentage 100 mul cvs strconcat "%)" strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.vt_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /result.vt_military_retirement_exemption xdef result.military_retirement_pay /result.vt_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"VT military retirement: NO EXEMPTION (AGI ≥ $175k). Retirement pay: $" result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", AGI: $" strconcat result.agi cvs strconcat ", Fully taxable" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exemption
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.vt_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.vt_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No VT military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Vermont state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure with 5 brackets per Vermont Department of Taxes (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Vermont Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.vt_state_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Head of Household
condition_details.condition_description: Filing Status is MFJ or HOH
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.filing_status "married_filing_jointly" strcasecmp 0 eq result.filing_status "head_of_household" strcasecmp 0 eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate VT tax for Single filers using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.vt_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /vt_agi xdef
vt_agi result.vt_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max dup /vt_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /vt_tax xdef
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_1_limit min result.vt_bracket_1_rate mul /vt_tax xdef
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_1_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_2_limit min result.vt_bracket_1_limit sub result.vt_bracket_2_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_2_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_3_limit min result.vt_bracket_2_limit sub result.vt_bracket_3_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_3_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_4_limit min result.vt_bracket_3_limit sub result.vt_bracket_4_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_4_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_4_limit sub result.vt_bracket_5_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_tax /result.vt_state_tax xdef vt_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Vermont tax calculated (Single): $" result.vt_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate VT tax for Married Filing Jointly/HOH using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.vt_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /vt_agi xdef
vt_agi result.vt_standard_deduction_joint sub 0 max dup /vt_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /vt_tax xdef
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_1_limit min result.vt_bracket_1_rate mul /vt_tax xdef
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_1_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_2_limit min result.vt_bracket_1_limit sub result.vt_bracket_2_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_2_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_3_limit min result.vt_bracket_2_limit sub result.vt_bracket_3_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_3_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_4_limit min result.vt_bracket_3_limit sub result.vt_bracket_4_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_4_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_4_limit sub result.vt_bracket_5_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_tax /result.vt_state_tax xdef vt_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Vermont tax calculated (MFJ/HOH): $" result.vt_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
